legacy_review.rationale: Replace restricted review dependency with eligible review; distinguish AF history detection from future incidence.
Use primary mITT population and bind endpoint/blanking definition to primary result; no secondary-arrhythmia overclaim.

Explainability accuracy and co-located AUC/ICI claims in the removed review are not source-equivalent to the new primary paper. Replace with scoped prediction/calibration cases; do not call a single paragraph multi-hop.
Reclassify distractor to synthesis: both stroke and no-reflow documents are required; preserve score variant and outcome.
The selected trial supports procedure/RF duration, not the old review’s fluoroscopy reduction percentage. New trade-off case uses verified durations.
Verify derivation combined versus best individual AUC; accept one genuinely equivalent complete abstract alternative.
Bind external validation to transportability/case-mix limitation; do not infer broad calibration from derivation alone.
Preserve source-reported adjusted predictor summary without asserting observational causation.
Remove false >0.93 premise; compare actual source-specific combined models as synthesis.
Preserve unresolved n=280/n=131 source conflict and reported EPV; do not invent a complete-case subset.
Use reported GLS change and its units; avoid silent recomputation/rounding reconciliation.
Bind denominators, follow-up and observed HF rehospitalization comparison; no causal risk reduction claim.
Reclassify multi-hop to direct lookup: one paragraph contains aggregate and within-group correlations; do not assert within-group linear relation.
Keep all three scoped biomarker percentages with treatment/control pairing; no mechanism or causal conclusion.
Diabetes-status interaction is not evidence of glycemic mediation independence; explicitly constrain the interpretation despite the source overclaim.
Physician RH-belief and screening percentages belong to the removed Singapore survey; consensus diagnostic work-up cannot supply them.
Survey training/exposure percentages cannot be transferred to Thai or Korean consensus epidemiology.
Survey referral/barrier percentages are not facts in the replacement consensus or primary studies.
Conflicting 43–55% referral figures are unresolved in the removed-source legacy case. Retire rather than selecting an unsupported reconciliation.
Separate incidence and sex-specific ROC evidence; distinguish sex-adjusted score variant from VASc/FMD competitor.
Overall and female adjusted estimates are co-located; classify direct lookup rather than artificial multi-hop.
Remove target percentage from the question; retain as intentional simple floor distinct from q065’s additional subgroup requirement.
Duplicate broad low-AUC narrative with the target range already supplied in the question. q044 now asks a neutral attributed comparison across score variants and endpoints.
Verify adjusted male platelet result and uncertainty; distinguish it from unadjusted hemoglobin and score.
AtriaNet segmentation claims from the removed AF review cannot be inferred from coronary imaging prediction or the replacement AF studies.
GDF-15 subcase duplicates the three-biomarker task; retain q056 with exact study-specific values.
AF review/physician-survey synthesis depends on both removed sources and does not have an equivalent source-bound referral answer.
Duplicate trial-outcome statement; q042 defines the primary mITT outcome and c004 explicitly contrasts review and primary reports.
Replace broad loosely related decoys with genuinely separated ROC/regression lookup; require adjusted column header binding.
CCTA/physician-survey synthesis cannot retain survey percentages. New synthesis compares diagnostic requirements with a trial phenotype limitation.
Connect FAI measurement/software to multivariable estimate; no unrelated score/drug decoy or causal mechanism inference.
Broad SGLT2 class naming is redundant and old survey evidence is unavailable; replace with organ/design-specific synthesis, avoiding transfer of clinical outcomes to genetic drug response.
Replace incidental biomarker decoy with one-table unadjusted/adjusted hemoglobin task; direct lookup classification.
Retire unsupported survey dependency; use exact unadjusted hypertension comparison and a real conflicting STEMI cohort as a scoped decoy.
